content: undici MockAgent intercepts the global fetch dispatcher (setGlobalDispatcher) and can simulate connectTimeout/headersTimeout/bodyTimeout via interceptor options or .delay(), and arbitrary status codes (429) via .reply(). Real TCP-level connection reset is not naturally reproduced by MockAgent (it mocks at the dispatcher/interceptor layer, not the socket layer) -- for a true ECONNRESET, a real socket-level tool (e.g. a TCP server that destroys the socket) or toxiproxy is needed.
